name: main-integration
body: The integration of a change-set into main: the single, gated act by which a project branch's work reaches the main checkout — `apg project merge <name>` (verify gate → merge → main rebuild → self-clean). Change-set integration runs through this gated act alone; raw git (merge/checkout/switch/worktree add-remove on main) sits outside agent change-set integration. The git scope covers the NAVIGATOR's raw git use only — the navigator's sole branch-state-mutating raw git command is rebasing the project worktree onto main, run inside the worktree. Other agents' main writes are separate, explicit carve-outs outside change-set integration: the `agent-builder` commits `.opencode/agents/**` and the repo's `opencode.json` agent→model map on main, and the optional `release-agent` (user-consented) performs `git push`/`git tag` as `ask`.
